verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־ מִיכָה֙ הַמֹּ֣רַשְׁתִּ֔י בִּימֵ֥י יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ חָזָ֥ה עַל־ שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וִירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’el- mî·ḵāh ham·mō·raš·tî bî·mê yō·w·ṯām ’ā·ḥāz yə·ḥiz·qî·yāh mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer- ḥā·zāh ‘al- šō·mə·rō·wn wî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: This is the word of the LORD that came to Micah the Moreshite in the days of Jotham Ahaz and Hezekiah kings of Judah what he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: PALAVRA do SENHOR, que veio a Miquéias, morastita, nos dias de Jotão, Acaz e Ezequias, reis de Judá, a qual ele viu sobre Samaria e Jerusalém.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ֙ עַמִּ֣ים כֻּלָּ֔ם הַקְשִׁ֖יבִי אֶ֣רֶץ וּמְלֹאָ֑הּ וִיהִי֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֤ה בָּכֶם֙ לְעֵ֔ד אֲדֹנָ֖י מֵהֵיכַ֥ל קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ‘am·mîm kul·lām haq·šî·ḇî ’e·reṣ ū·mə·lō·’āh wî·hî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bā·ḵem lə·‘êḏ ’ă·ḏō·nāy mê·hê·ḵal qā·ḏə·šōw
verses.literal: Hear O peoples all of you listen O earth and everyone in it May the Lord GOD bear witness against you the Lord from His holy temple
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, todos os povos, presta atenção, ó terra, e tudo o que nela há; e seja o Senhor DEUS testemunha contra vós, o Senhor, desde o seu santo templo.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה יֹצֵ֣א מִמְּקוֹמ֑וֹ וְיָרַ֥ד וְדָרַ֖ךְ עַל־ בָּמוֹתֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh Yah·weh yō·ṣê mim·mə·qō·w·mōw wə·yā·raḏ wə·ḏā·raḵ ‘al- bå̄·mō·ṯē ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For behold the LORD comes forth from His dwelling place He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth
verses.literalPt: Porque eis que o SENHOR está para sair do seu lugar, e descerá, e andará sobre as alturas da terra.

verses.original: וְנָמַ֤סּוּ הֶֽהָרִים֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְהָעֲמָקִ֖ים יִתְבַּקָּ֑עוּ כַּדּוֹנַג֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ כְּמַ֖יִם מֻגָּרִ֥ים בְּמוֹרָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·mas·sū he·hā·rîm taḥ·tāw wə·hā·‘ă·mā·qîm yiṯ·baq·qā·‘ū kad·dō·w·naḡ mip·pə·nê hā·’êš kə·ma·yim mug·gā·rîm bə·mō·w·rāḏ
verses.literal: The mountains will melt beneath Him and the valleys will split apart like wax before the fire like water rushing down a slope
verses.literalPt: E os montes debaixo dele se derreterão, e os vales se fenderão, como a cera diante do fogo, como as águas que se precipitam num abismo.

verses.original: בְּפֶ֤שַׁע יַֽעֲקֹב֙ כָּל־ זֹ֔את וּבְחַטֹּ֖אות בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִֽי־ פֶ֣שַׁע יַעֲקֹ֗ב הֲלוֹא֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וּמִי֙ בָּמ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֔ה הֲל֖וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·p̄e·ša‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ kāl- zōṯ ū·ḇə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl mî- p̄e·ša‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ hă·lō·w šō·mə·rō·wn ū·mî bā·mō·wṯ yə·hū·ḏāh hă·lō·w yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: All this is for the transgression of Jacob and the sins of the house of Israel What is the transgression of Jacob Is it not Samaria And what is the high place of Judah Is it not Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Tudo isto por causa da transgressão de Jacó, e dos pecados da casa de Israel. Qual é a transgressão de Jacó? Não é Samaria? E quais os altos de Judá? Não é Jerusalém?

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י שֹׁמְר֛וֹן לְעִ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לְמַטָּ֣עֵי כָ֑רֶם וְהִגַּרְתִּ֤י לַגַּי֙ אֲבָנֶ֔יהָ וִיסֹדֶ֖יהָ אֲגַלֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî šō·mə·rō·wn lə·‘î haś·śā·ḏeh lə·maṭ·ṭā·‘ê ḵā·rem wə·hig·gar·tî lag·gay ’ă·ḇā·ne·hā wî·sō·ḏe·hā ’ă·ḡal·leh
verses.literal: Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble in the open field a planting area for a vineyard I will pour her stones into the valley and expose her foundations
verses.literalPt: Por isso farei de Samaria um montão de pedras do campo, uma terra de plantar vinhas, e farei rolar as suas pedras no vale, e descobrirei os seus fundamentos.

verses.original: וְכָל־ פְּסִילֶ֣יהָ יֻכַּ֗תּוּ וְכָל־ אֶתְנַנֶּ֙יהָ֙ יִשָּׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֔שׁ וְכָל־ עֲצַבֶּ֖יהָ אָשִׂ֣ים שְׁמָמָ֑ה כִּ֠י מֵאֶתְנַ֤ן זוֹנָה֙ קִבָּ֔צָה וְעַד־ אֶתְנַ֥ן זוֹנָ֖ה יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl pə·sî·le·hā yuk·kat·tū wə·ḵāl ’eṯ·nan·ne·hā yiś·śā·rə·p̄ū ḇā·’êš wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ṣab·be·hā ’ā·śîm šə·mā·māh kî mê·’eṯ·nan zō·w·nāh qib·bā·ṣāh wə·‘aḏ- ’eṯ·nan zō·w·nāh yā·šū·ḇū
verses.literal: All her carved images will be smashed to pieces all her wages will be burned in the fire and I will destroy . . . all her idols Since she collected . . . the wages of a prostitute they will be used again on a prostitute
verses.literalPt: E todas as suas imagens de escultura serão despedaçadas, e todas as suas ofertas serão queimadas pelo fogo, e de todos os seus ídolos eu farei uma assolação; porque pela paga de prostituta os ajuntou, e para a paga de prostituta voltarão.

verses.original: עַל־ זֹאת֙ אֶסְפְּדָ֣ה וְאֵילִ֔ילָה אֵילְכָ֥ה שֵׁילָל וְעָר֑וֹם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה מִסְפֵּד֙ כַּתַּנִּ֔ים וְאֵ֖בֶל כִּבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- zōṯ ’es·pə·ḏāh wə·’ê·lî·lāh ’ê·lə·ḵāh šē·lå̄l wə·‘ā·rō·wm ’e·‘ĕ·śeh mis·pêḏ kat·tan·nîm wə·’ê·ḇel kiḇ·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: Because of this I will lament and wail I will walk barefoot and naked I will howl . . . like a jackal and mourn like an ostrich
verses.literalPt: Por isso lamentarei, e gemerei, andarei despojado e nu; farei lamentação como de chacais, e pranto como de avestruzes.

verses.original: כִּ֥י אֲנוּשָׁ֖ה מַכּוֹתֶ֑יהָ כִּי־ בָ֙אָה֙ עַד־ יְהוּדָ֔ה נָגַ֛ע עַד־ שַׁ֥עַר עַמִּ֖י עַד־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nū·šāh mak·kō·w·ṯe·hā kî- ḇā·’āh ‘aḏ- yə·hū·ḏāh nā·ḡa‘ ‘aḏ- ša·‘ar ‘am·mî ‘aḏ- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: For her wound is incurable it has reached . . . even Judah it has approached the gate of my people . . . as far as Jerusalem itself
verses.literalPt: Porque a sua chaga é incurável, porque chegou até Judá; estendeu-se até à porta do meu povo, até Jerusalém.

verses.original: בְּגַת֙ אַל־ תַּגִּ֔ידוּ בָּכ֖וֹ אַל־ תִּבְכּ֑וּ בְּבֵ֣ית לְעַפְרָ֔ה עָפָ֖ר הִתְפַּלָּשְׁתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḡaṯ ’al- tag·gî·ḏū bā·ḵōw ’al- tiḇ·kū bə·ḇêṯ lə·‘ap̄·rāh ‘ā·p̄ār hiṯ·pal·lå̄·šə·tī
verses.literal: Do not tell it in Gath do not weep . . . at all Roll in the dust in Beth-leaphrah
verses.literalPt: Não o anuncieis em Gate, nem choreis muito; revolve-te no pó, na casa de Afra.

verses.original: עִבְרִ֥י לָכֶ֛ם יוֹשֶׁ֥בֶת שָׁפִ֖יר עֶרְיָה־ בֹ֑שֶׁת לֹ֤א יָֽצְאָה֙ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צַֽאֲנָ֔ן מִסְפַּד֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֵ֔צֶל יִקַּ֥ח מִכֶּ֖ם עֶמְדָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘iḇ·rî lā·ḵem yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ šā·p̄îr ‘er·yāh- ḇō·šeṯ lō yā·ṣə·’āh yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ ṣa·’ă·nān mis·paḏ bêṯ hā·’ê·ṣel yiq·qaḥ mik·kem ‘em·dā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Depart in shameful nakedness O dwellers of Shaphir The dwellers of Zaanan will not come out Beth-ezel is in mourning its support is taken from you
verses.literalPt: Passa, ó moradora de Safir, em vergonhosa nudez; a moradora de Zaanã não saiu; o pranto de Bete-Ezel tirará de vós a sua posição.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חָ֥לָֽה לְט֖וֹב יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת מָר֑וֹת כִּֽי־ יָ֤רַד רָע֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְשַׁ֖עַר יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥā·lāh lə·ṭō·wḇ yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ mā·rō·wṯ kî- yā·raḏ rā‘ mê·’êṯ Yah·weh lə·ša·‘ar yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good but calamity came down from the LORD even to the gate of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Porque a moradora de Marote sofre pelo bem; porque desceu do SENHOR o mal até à porta de Jerusalém.

verses.original: רְתֹ֧ם הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֛ה לָרֶ֖כֶשׁ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָכִ֑ישׁ רֵאשִׁ֨ית חַטָּ֥את הִיא֙ לְבַת־ צִיּ֔וֹן כִּי־ בָ֥ךְ נִמְצְא֖וּ פִּשְׁעֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ṯōm ham·mer·kā·ḇāh lā·re·ḵeš yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ lā·ḵîš rê·šîṯ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ hî lə·ḇaṯ- ṣî·yō·wn kî- ḇāḵ nim·ṣə·’ū piš·‘ê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Harness your chariot horses O dweller of Lachish You were the beginning of sin to the Daughter of Zion for the transgressions of Israel were found in you
verses.literalPt: Ata os animais ligeiros ao carro, ó moradora de Laquis; esta foi o princípio do pecado para a filha de Sião, porque em ti se acharam as transgressões de Israel.

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ תִּתְּנִ֣י שִׁלּוּחִ֔ים עַ֖ל מוֹרֶ֣שֶׁת גַּ֑ת בָּתֵּ֤י אַכְזִיב֙ לְאַכְזָ֔ב לְמַלְכֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên tit·tə·nî šil·lū·ḥîm ‘al mō·w·re·šeṯ gaṯ bāt·tê ’aḵ·zîḇ lə·’aḵ·zāḇ lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore send farewell gifts to Moresheth-gath the houses of Achzib will prove deceptive to the kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Por isso darás presentes a Moresete-Gate; as casas de Aczibe se tornarão em engano para os reis de Israel.

verses.original: עֹ֗ד הַיֹּרֵשׁ֙ אָ֣בִי לָ֔ךְ יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מָֽרֵשָׁ֑ה עַד־ עֲדֻּלָּ֥ם יָב֖וֹא כְּב֥וֹד יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ōḏ hay·yō·rêš ’ā·ḇî lāḵ yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ mā·rê·šāh ‘aḏ- ʿăd·dul·lå̄m yā·ḇō·w kə·ḇō·wḏ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: I will again bring a conqueror against you O dweller of Mareshah The glory of Israel will come to Adullam
verses.literalPt: Ainda trarei a ti, ó moradora de Maressa, aquele que te possuirá; chegará até Adulão a glória de Israel.

verses.original: קָרְחִ֣י וָגֹ֔זִּי עַל־ בְּנֵ֖י תַּעֲנוּגָ֑יִךְ הַרְחִ֤בִי קָרְחָתֵךְ֙ כַּנֶּ֔שֶׁר כִּ֥י גָל֖וּ מִמֵּֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·ḥî wā·ḡōz·zî ‘al- bə·nê ta·‘ă·nū·ḡā·yiḵ har·ḥi·ḇî qā·rə·ḥā·ṯêḵ kan·ne·šer kî ḡā·lū mim·mêḵ
verses.literal: Shave yourselves bald and cut off your hair in mourning for your precious children make yourselves as bald as an eagle for they will go from you into exile
verses.literalPt: Faze-te calva, e tosquia-te, por causa dos filhos das tuas delícias; alarga a tua calva como a águia, porque de ti foram levados cativos.
